title: Add new schedule opens the dialog
preconditions: Budget open on the budget page.
expected: The Schedules list opens at /schedules with the title «Schedules».
A dialog titled «Schedule» opens over the list. It shows «Cancel» and «Add» buttons.
The dialog closes and no new row appears in the list.

title: New schedule dialog defaults
expected: The «Schedule» dialog opens.
«Repeats» is checked.

step: Look at the «Automatically add transaction» checkbox.
expected: It is unchecked.

step: Look at the Amount field and the amount operator button.
expected: Amount shows 0.00 and the operator button reads «is approximately».
It reads «Every month on the 26th» (the current day of the month on another day).

title: Add with an empty form
preconditions: Schedules list open. Note the current number of rows.
expected: The «Schedule» dialog opens with all fields empty.
«Add» is enabled.
The dialog closes and no error message is shown.

step: Look at the new row in the list.
expected: A row has Name «None», Payee «None», Account «None», Status «Due» and Amount «~0.00». The next date is today's date.

title: Add a schedule with a name
expected: The «Schedule» dialog opens.
The text appears in the field.
The dialog closes.

step: Look for the name in the list.
expected: A row with the typed name exists with Status «Due».

title: Very long schedule name
preconditions: Schedules list open. Prepare a name of about 180 characters starting with reconqa-.
expected: The «Schedule» dialog opens.

step: Paste the long name into «Schedule Name».
expected: The whole text is accepted and no limit message appears.
The dialog closes. The list row shows the full name.

title: End options of the repeat
step: Click «Add new schedule», then click the Date button.
expected: The Date popup opens. The end option button reads «indefinitely».
The options are «indefinitely», «for» and «until».
A number box appears with value 1 and the text «occurrences».

title: Repeat units
step: Click «Add new schedule», then click the Date button.
expected: The Date popup opens. The unit button reads «Months» and the Repeat every box shows 1.
The options are «Days», «Weeks», «Months» and «Years».
The unit button reads «Weeks». The button «Add specific days» is no longer shown.
The button «Add specific days» is shown.

title: Repeats unchecked gives a single date
expected: The «Schedule» dialog opens.
The Date button is replaced by one date text box showing today's date.
Only one date is listed.

title: Amount operator options
expected: The operator button reads «is approximately».
The options are «is approximately», «is exactly» and «is between».
Two amount boxes appear, each with a «Make positive» button, joined by the text «and».

title: Repeat every 0 is accepted
step: Click «Add new schedule», then click the Date button.
expected: The Date popup opens.

step: Choose «Weeks» as the unit and «for» as the end option; leave the occurrences at 1.
expected: The unit button reads «Weeks».
No message appears.
The popup closes. The Date button reads «Every week on Thursday, once».

title: Upcoming length options
expected: The Upcoming length button reads «Use global default».
The options are «Use global default», «1 day», «1 week», «2 weeks», «1 month», «End of the current month» and «Custom length».

title: Columns of the schedule list
expected: The columns, in order, are «Name», «Payee», «Account», «Next date», «Status», «Amount» and «Recurring».

step: Look for a column called Due date.
expected: No such column exists.
